title: [review] message.rs:233: DAO write_to can produce inval
description: When dodag_id is None and rpl_instance_id < 0x80 (global ID), write_to sets D=1 in the header (line 238) but only writes 4 bytes without DODAGID bytes. The validation at line 230-231 only rejects dodag_id=None for local instance IDs (0x80+). A parser receiving this malformed packet will expect 20 bytes (D=1) but only 4 are present, causing decode failures. Since the comment says 'D-flag always set (LICHEN/SCHC rule 4)', the fix should require dodag_id to always be Some, not just for local IDs.
close_reason: Fixed: require dodag_id to always be Some in DAO write_to since D-flag is always set per LICHEN/SCHC rule 4. Added test to verify global instance IDs (< 0x80) with None dodag_id are rejected.
